author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407 I have never really thought about the Spelling Bee as a pedagogical routine. Was it the OG gamification in #literacies teaching?

I will need to think about this. It clearly motivated you to learn spell. I know learning games were about the only time I would be picked first or second for any team in school and that made me feel proud, felt like I had a bit of power restored.

And I believe the people who excel at spelling bees must know the rules of spelling more than simply a treasure chest of words.
